caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned vertically in the center of the page on a plain, light background. It features a long, thin stick at the bottom that supports a large, pink flower with ruffled petals and several green leaves nestled among the petals. Above the flower, there is an egg-shaped object that is off-white or pale yellow, adorned in its center with a symmetrical, blue floral or star-like motif composed of pointed, radiating segments. On top of the egg-shaped object is a small, round, translucent ornament topped with a metallic crown or cap. The composition of the drawing is vertically aligned and centrally placed, with soft, delicate colors: mostly pink, green, blue, and off-white. In the lower right corner, a faint signature in blue ink reads "Ann Gem. Buckley."
title: Cascarone
